Name: (DGA) Animal Enrichment
Author: Fippsie
Description:
[center]This mod adds animal enrichment decorations to the game.

[img]https://abload.de/img/buttons1jtd.png[/img]﻿
1. Install the latest version of SMAPI.
2. Install the latest version of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9365]Dynamic Game Assets[/url] and all requirements.﻿﻿
3. Download the mod and then unzip the folder into \Stardew Valley\Mods\.
4. Run the game using SMAPI.

[img]https://abload.de/img/button3bljhi.png[/img]
You can buy the small enrichment items at Marnie's Ranch.
The small enrichment item costs 1500 the big enrichment items costs 2500.
The items are purely aesthetic for now and have no functions right now.

﻿[/center]
